stories.title: Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO, board chair
stories.take: Huang is back as CEO and board chair after Trump told the board he did nothing wrong — the scandal ends with a reinstatement, not a resignation.

stories.title: Inside Nvidia, Not Everyone Is Celebrating Jensen Huang’s Return
stories.take: Inside Nvidia the mood is split: some staff saw Huang's exit as a chance for culture change and are openly dreading the old regime's return.

stories.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes
stories.take: Anthropic's Claude Ship lets AI agents review, fix and approve code changes — the bottleneck moves from writing code to trusting the reviewer.

stories.title: Amazon snaps up Decart’s AI optimization tech for $7.5B as it prepares to sell Trainium chips
stories.take: Amazon pays a reported $7.5B for Decart's AI optimization tech and team as it gets ready to sell its own Trainium chips to outsiders.

stories.title: CrowdStrike to acquire Zscaler for $44 billion
stories.take: CrowdStrike buys zero-trust rival Zscaler for $44B, pitching the combined stack as the security layer for the AI agent era.

stories.title: Google Search’s AI Mode can now tap into Drive and Wallet for more personalized responses
stories.take: Google Search's AI Mode can now pull from Drive and Wallet — personalization deepens, and so does the amount of your life in the answer.

stories.title: States sue SpaceX to stop Grok from generating child sex images, revenge porn
stories.take: State attorneys general sue SpaceX, saying Grok still generates child sex images and revenge porn despite X's claim that every output is screened.

stories.title: Sierra doubles valuation to $30B within six months as demand for AI in CX takes off
stories.take: Sierra, Bret Taylor's AI customer-experience startup, doubles to a $30B valuation in six months on a $1.75B Series F.

stories.title: Agencies are selling AI efficiency — clients want outcomes
stories.take: Agencies spent two years selling AI as a cost cut; clients nodded, waited, and now want outcomes instead of efficiency decks.

stories.title: The next test for agentic media
stories.take: Agentic media's next test is interoperability — every advertiser's agents, data and rules have to work inside everyone else's stack.

stories.title: Intuit offloads Mailchimp to Bending Spoons to deepen bets on AI
stories.take: Intuit sells Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for less than a third of the $12B it paid in 2021, doubling down on AI instead of email.

stories.title: Modelo Becomes First Official Beer of the NCAA
stories.take: Modelo becomes the NCAA's first official beer, with March Madness as the centerpiece across 90-plus championships.

stories.title: Gap Inc. is betting on ‘fashiontainment’ to fuel growth
stories.take: Gap Inc. bets on 'fashiontainment' — a boy-band partnership and a scripted Banana Republic microseries — to make the brands cultural again.

stories.title: How GTA 6’s interface kept the classic Pricedown font but still managed to feel modern
stories.take: Rockstar's UI team kept GTA 6's classic Pricedown font and rebuilt everything around it, with accessibility designed in from the start.

stories.title: Vocal Green swats back at online critics, fuels Warriors' victory over Celtics
stories.take: Draymond Green spent the day firing back at critics online, then closed out Golden State's 88-87 win over Boston with a last-second stop.

stories.title: Spurs rule Wembanyama, Fox out 90 minutes before tipoff against Kings
stories.take: San Antonio ruled Wembanyama and Fox out 90 minutes before tipoff against Sacramento; both are expected back Wednesday.

stories.take: Too-early All-Star picks, three months out: the 24 most deserving players right now, and the position battles worth watching.

stories.take: Grading the Skubal deal: New York landed the winter's top free agent, and the price resets what an ace costs.

stories.take: With a lockout looming, MLB raises its minimum-salary offer and floats earlier pay for young players; the union counters on media money.

stories.take: CBA talks, tracked: league and union trade revenue-sharing proposals with the Dec. 1 deadline now a week away.

stories.title: Sources: Cubs shore up rotation, agree to free agent deal with LHP Rogers
stories.take: Chicago shores up its rotation with a five-year deal for free-agent lefty Trevor Rogers.

stories.title: MLB offseason grades: Mets keep spending, grab ex-Yank Goldschmidt
stories.take: Offseason grades so far: the Mets keep spending, adding ex-Yankee Paul Goldschmidt to the Skubal splurge.

stories.title: Federal court clears way for army to detonate bomb-making chemicals in Iowa
stories.take: A federal appeals court clears the Army to detonate tons of degraded bomb-making chemicals in Iowa, over the state's objections.

stories.title: Federal appeals court gives President Donald Trump a path to erasing hush money conviction
stories.take: An appeals court gives Trump a path to erase his hush-money conviction, moving the case to federal court where immunity could end it.

stories.title: Democrats win House by largest margin in 50 years. And, COP31 ends with no deal
stories.take: Democrats have flipped 47 House seats — their largest win in 50 years — and COP31 closes as the longest climate summit ever, with no deal.

stories.take: COP31 ends in failure, the first summit since 2009 with no consensus, split over fossil fuels and climate finance.

stories.take: The Senate leadership vote is the new Democratic majority's first test of its promise to shake up Washington.

stories.title: Trump administration deported US citizen to Mexico, DoJ admits in court
stories.take: The Justice Department admits in court that the Trump administration deported a U.S. citizen from Texas to Mexico by mistake.

stories.take: Storms on both coasts threaten Thanksgiving travel just as airlines recover from a run of tech failures.

stories.take: L.A. Rep. Jimmy Gomez quits after the House ethics panel finds substantial evidence he made unwanted sexual advances toward a staffer.

stories.take: California sues to block a Trump rule denying housing aid to mixed-status families — about 7,000 California households stand to lose it.

stories.take: California has confirmed 60 measles cases this year, more than the past two years combined, days after the U.S. lost elimination status.

stories.title: Republican sheriff racked up $3m security bill for California taxpayers, including Ritz-Carlton stays and steak
stories.take: A Southern California county spent over $3M in a year guarding Sheriff Chad Bianco during his failed run for governor — Ritz-Carlton stays included.

stories.take: California's universities are building their own AI data centers rather than waiting on commercial cloud capacity.

stories.take: L.A. and Long Beach port workers call off a strike at the last minute, averting a holiday-season shutdown.

stories.title: Jensen Huang Is Back at Nvidia. What’s Next?
stories.take: What's next, per WSJ: Huang returns with guardrails — a new board chairman role and a national security committee on chip exports — while congressional briefings loom next week and tougher export controls look like the lasting legacy • His reinstatement added nearly $1 trillion to Nvidia's market cap in a day, the biggest one-day gain ever for a U.S. company; Nasdaq +6.5%, S&P +4.7% • Trump sent JD Vance to assure the board Huang was no security risk, 11 days after he resigned over affairs, one with a suspected Chinese intelligence contact • Also: CrowdStrike's $44B Zscaler deal, and Trump halts the Army's plan to detonate ~10,000 lb of lead azide in Iowa

stories.title: Trump's Mission to Get Jensen Huang Back at Nvidia
stories.take: Biographer Stephen Witt: Huang ran a war room and lobbied straight to Trump — 'He's the trillion dollar man. He's too big to fire' • Witt calls the return great for shareholders but terrible for the rule of law, and predicts aggressive hearings when Democrats take power • NYT's Jonathan Swan: Trump sees Huang as a 'golden goose,' dismissed a Rubio memo on the spy concerns, and built a moat — any wrongdoing at Nvidia, but not by Huang • Huang's irreplaceable asset is vision: he built robot brains a decade before the robots existed

stories.title: Jensen's back, back again
stories.take: Huang's 11-day exile ends (Altman's took five); 200,000+ signed a 'stand with Jensen' letter, and the board cited government assurances he is no security threat • The flip side: one man worth ~$1 trillion signals an economy that is 'not the most stable or resilient,' and the pre-scandal AI questions are still unanswered • 82% of businesses report rising material costs — highest since 1999 — on fuel, labor, tariffs and AI construction demand • Kansas farmers: a tractor is now $700,000, wheat sells $2 below the cost of production

stories.title: Rep. Jimmy Gomez steps down, Port strike avoided, Bracing for this week's king tides — Evening Edition
stories.take: Rep. Jimmy Gomez resigns effective Dec. 1 after the Ethics Committee found substantial evidence of unwelcome advances toward a staffer • Port security workers reach a tentative deal, averting an LA/Long Beach strike — ratification still pending • King tides over 8 feet peak Wednesday and Thursday; sandbags redirect water rather than stop it • LAX holiday tips: the 96th and Vicksburg entrance, Metro C/K lines plus the free shuttle, FlyAway every ~30 minutes

stories.title: Olympics security could cost $3 billion, Riverside's  Mission Inn Festival of Lights returns,  Dodgers pitcher Tarik Skubal is leaving LA—Afternoon Edition
stories.take: Sheriff Luna: 2028 Olympics security could cost $3 billion — triple the $1 billion federal set-aside — with up to 30,000 extra officers; LAPD's chief has floated $4 billion • Chief McDonald's future is still undecided, and he argues removing him would disrupt Games planning • Riverside's Mission Inn Festival of Lights is back, free nightly through Dec. 31 • Dodgers lefty Tarik Skubal leaves LA for the Mets' record nine-year, $450M deal

stories.title: Unreleased songs from before Tom Petty was a star
stories.take: A jury convicts Jonathan Rinderknecht in the Palisades Fire retrial on a fully circumstantial case — phone data, his own statements, and a ChatGPT query about cigarette liability; he faces 5–20 years per charge • After Delta's 1,600 delayed flights and bank outages, experts blame AI stress-testing upgrades and advise a week of cash at home and autopay set a few days early • Resy and OpenTable turn your phone number into a diner profile; OpenTable's Global Insights starts sharing it across restaurants • Tom Petty's 'Origins' box set: Adria Petty and Ron Blair on a 20-year-old who was already 'fully formed' in Gainesville
